name: alpine-yubikey
initializeCommand: bash -c '[ -f /tmp/socat-gpg.pid ] && kill $(cat /tmp/socat-gpg.pid) 2>/dev/null; nohup socat TCP-LISTEN:17000,reuseaddr,fork UNIX-CONNECT:${HOME}/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/socat-gpg.pid; sleep 1'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'pkill socat 2>/dev/null || true; pkill gpg-agent 2>/dev/null || true; pkill scdaemon 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 0.5; rm -f /root/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent; nohup socat UNIX-LISTEN:/root/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent,fork TCP:host.docker.internal:17000 >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 1'
